data.narrative:
Adarga is a Series B-stage defense and security software company that has raised $26.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage. Key private comparables include Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), and Heven AeroTech ($1.0B).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression, anchoring to total capital raised ($26.2M) and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies a valuation of $50M. The peer-median method captures the central tendency across the 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables, yielding a median valuation of $1.1B (range: $300M–$3.0B). This dispersion reflects material variance in maturity, revenue, and market positioning within the peer set.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $42M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $587M. The wide band reflects tension between stage-based progression and peer multiples. Stage advancement alone suggests a floor near $42M–$50M; however, peer valuations indicate substantially higher valuations are supportable if Adarga demonstrates comparable revenue traction or strategic positioning. Key uncertainties include revenue scale, customer concentration, and defensibility relative to peers—data not available in this analysis.
